name: Ventricular cardiomyocyte coupling, adhesion and T-tubule organization
rationale: All members concern how cardiomyocytes couple electrically and structurally (gap junctions, ventricular action potential, depolarization control, T-tubules); cardiomyocyte adhesion and T-tubule organization separate it from conduction-system and calcium-handling confusables.

qualifier: BAF and CHD complexes with protein acetylation
name: BAF and CHD chromatin remodeling with protein acetylation
rationale: Members center on nucleosome remodeling complexes (BAF variants, CHD, NuRD, ChAHP) and histone/protein acetylation, unlike confusables focused on histone methylation, deacetylation or chromosome condensation.

name: Thyroid hormone action and sulfate-iodide anion transport
rationale: Members span thyroid hormone generation, transport and signaling together with SLC26/iodide/sulfate/PAPS anion handling, which the selenium- and peroxide-focused confusables lack.

qualifier: splicing, 3' end processing, export and decay
name: Pre-mRNA splicing, 3' processing, export and surveillance decay
rationale: Members cover spliceosome and snRNP biogenesis, mRNA 3' end processing, nuclear export, and NMD/no-go/ribosome-quality-control decay, whereas the main confusable is rRNA and ribosome biogenesis.

name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta clearance
rationale: Members concern microglial proliferation, migration, activation and cytotoxicity plus clearance of amyloid-beta and apoptotic cells, with amyloid fibril regulation distinguishing it from TREM2/DAP12-type confusables.

name: p75NTR signaling in neuronal death and axon regeneration
rationale: Members describe p75NTR ligand binding, proteolysis and death/survival outputs alongside axon growth inhibition and regeneration, which the collateral-sprouting and Trk-signaling confusables each only partly cover.

name: Epithelial solute carrier transport with cystine reabsorption
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane SLC transporter modules of liver and kidney epithelia plus cystine transport and cystinuria, distinguishing it from neutral amino acid, peptide and urate transport confusables.

qualifier: leptin, ghrelin and growth hormone signaling
name: Leptin, ghrelin and growth hormone control of feeding and growth
rationale: Members cover appetite and feeding behavior, nutrient-response regulation and organismal growth through leptin, ghrelin and growth hormone signaling, unlike gut-hormone GPCR, prolactin or glucocorticoid confusables.

name: Vocal learning, sensorimotor gating and social behavior
rationale: Members are behaviors driven by auditory, visual and mechanosensory input, vocalization, observational learning and social interaction (with striatal development), unlike locomotor or MECP2 confusables.

name: Thyroid hormone receptor nuclear transcriptional signaling
rationale: Members concern cellular responses to thyroid hormone via nuclear receptor transcription and receptor SUMOylation, unlike confusables on thyroid hormone synthesis and transport, LXR or sex-steroid signaling.

name: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance of KIT mutants
rationale: All members describe KIT mutants binding or resisting kinase inhibitors, distinguishing it from FLT3 and PDGFR resistance and from KIT oncogenic signaling confusables.

qualifier: negative feedback with AP-1 and IL-6 outputs
name: ERK MAPK negative feedback with AP-1 and IL-6 signaling
rationale: Members cover ERK1/2, ERK5 and atypical MAPK activation and their phosphatase-mediated attenuation, linked to AP-1 and IL-6/STAT3 signaling, unlike upstream RAS/RAF or JNK/p38 activation confusables.

core: Motile cilium and sperm axoneme assembly
name: Motile cilium and sperm axoneme assembly with tubulin modification
rationale: Members concern motile axoneme and dynein arm assembly, sperm flagellum structure, multiciliogenesis and tubulin folding/polyglutamylation, the latter separating it from intraflagellar transport and centrosome confusables.

name: Tight junction assembly and endothelial barrier regulation
rationale: All members regulate tight junction assembly, localization and disassembly or endothelial barrier function, whereas confusables concern adherens junctions and cadherin adhesion.

qualifier: sperm capacitation, motility and acrosome reaction
name: Sperm capacitation, motility, acrosome reaction and fertilization
rationale: Members cover sperm maturation and motility, acrosome reaction, zona pellucida binding and egg activation, unlike confusables on axoneme assembly, germ cell development or the maternal-zygotic transition.

name: TCR signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members concern proximal and downstream TCR signaling and its tuning by CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition, which the T cell differentiation and BCR confusables lack.

name: Neuronal dendrite branching and arborization
rationale: All three members concern growth of dendritic arbors, unlike confusables on filopodia, postsynaptic actin or synapse structure.

name: Rac and RhoG-driven lamellipodial actin polymerization
rationale: Members are RAC1/2/3 and RHOG cycles with their WAVE/Arp2/3, lamellipodium and NADPH oxidase outputs, distinguishing it from CDC42/RHOA cycle and Fc-gamma phagocytosis confusables.

name: Lymphocyte immunological synapse and polarity via Rho GTPases
rationale: Members concern immunological synapse and membrane raft organization, T cell polarity and lymphocyte aggregation through RHOH, CDC42 and CORO1A-DEF6 effectors, unlike integrin adhesion, homing or antigen-presentation confusables.

name: Gonadotropin, activin and AMH control of gonad function
rationale: Members cover gonadotropin, activin, AMH and progesterone signaling regulating follicle growth, ovulation, oocyte maturation and testicular somatic cells, unlike sex-determination or germ cell migration confusables.

name: De novo purine synthesis and thiopurine drug metabolism
rationale: Members concern de novo IMP/AMP/GMP/GTP synthesis, nucleotide triphosphate turnover and azathioprine/TPMT handling, distinguishing it from pyrimidine, purine salvage and nucleoside transport confusables.

name: Regulation of MHC class II peptide antigen presentation
rationale: All members concern regulating peptide antigen processing and loading onto MHC class II, whereas confusables describe monocyte/DC signatures, lipid antigen presentation or the core presentation pathway itself.

name: DNA and histone methylation in silencing and imprinting
rationale: Members concern DNA methylation, PRC2 and arginine/lysine methylation driving gene silencing, imprinting and facultative heterochromatin, unlike WDR5/MLL activating methylation or demethylase confusables.

name: Keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis balance
rationale: All members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation or death, whereas confusables concern skin appendages, barrier formation or wound migration.

name: Inhibition of integrin adhesion, cell spreading and lamellipodia
rationale: All members negatively regulate cell-matrix adhesion, integrin and Rho/Rac signaling, spreading, ruffles and lamellipodia, whereas confusables promote protrusion or concern invadopodia and wound migration.
